verdict.rationale: Teller's docs pages are fetchable as raw markdown (e.g., /docs/api/account/balances.md, /docs/api/webhooks.md, /docs/guides/sandbox.md), which gives an agent clean per-page docs to read. However, probes show no llms.txt (404), no root docs.md (404), and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path, so there is no agent-oriented index or machine-readable entry point. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, a root markdown docs entry point, a published OpenAPI spec, and any explicit first-party statement that the docs are intended for agents.
